title: OpenEMR before 8.3.0 contains an insecure direct object reference in portal/lib/paylib.php, which writes the…
description: OpenEMR versions prior to 8.3.0 have an insecure direct object reference vulnerability in portal/lib/paylib.php. This flaw allows authenticated portal patients to manipulate payment audit records of other patients by submitting crafted requests that alter billing records without proper session validation.
